question.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1}$, ${a}_{2}$, and $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$ from the decomposition $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 7\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
We know that $b\in \text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}$ if there exist ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ -3\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 7\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-5 \\ -3{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=7\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & -5 \\ -3 & 1 & 7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-3 & 1 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 12\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The third row of the augmented matrix now corresponds to the equation $0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}=12,$ which has no solution.

So, there are no values of ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2} & =b.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that $b$ does *not* lie in $\text{Span}\{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}\}.$
